ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% low-intensity (black) pixels to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity regions dominate the leading edge and the entirety of the left lobe; high-intensity mottled geometric blobs and focal spots are concentrated on the right lobe, primarily along the trailing edge and medial surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate 160-degree interior angle; vertex depth is minimal relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medium-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the continuous trailing boundary; distinct pixel-level peaks are visible on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the outer margins, tapering to sharp, slightly upturned distal tips at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple vertical, low-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) traversing the high-intensity mottled region on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged distal margin on the right fluke tip suggesting minor structural trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between lobes; the right lobe exhibits complex stochastic mottling while the left lobe is almost entirely monochromatic low-intensity.
